reliability: Primary agency description of its workflow/rule; reliable within stated scope, not independent customer-demand evidence. HTTP 200 public HTML read on access date.
findings: Medicare remittance advice can cover multiple claims; adjustments can occur at line, claim and provider level, with standardized reason codes.
CMS states that electronic remittance advice enables automated posting to accounting or billing applications and avoids staff manually posting paper remittance information.
CMS identifies free PC Print for institutional providers and Medicare Easy Print for professional providers, including viewing/printing and MREP report export functionality.
limitations: Medicare workflow guidance does not show how many small practices still post manually, their error rates, or willingness to buy a new tool.
Page last-modified label is September 10, 2024; original publication date unknown. Described tool availability was not independently installed or tested.
Do not generalize these Medicare details to every commercial payer.
title: Health Care Payment and Remittance Advice
